doc.name: Corey James portfolio agent
doc.description: Answers about the work of Corey James, an AI systems architect and research engineer: evidence-cited fit reports for a role, search over the systems, stories, capabilities and patent applications, the agent gallery of roles assembled from specialist agents, and contact. Every figure returned is one on the page it cites. Every page is also published as a repository document at https://github.com/coreyjames-ai and mirrored at https://gitlab.com/coreyjames-ai.

skills.name: Fit report for a role
skills.description: Give a job description or a list of requirements; returns, per requirement, the pages and figures on coreyjames.ai that demonstrate it, with coverage as covered, partial or gap. Cites, never asserts.
examples: Does Corey James fit a Principal Engineer, AI infrastructure role that needs CUDA, KV-cache memory management and governance of coding agents?

skills.name: Search the work
skills.description: A topic, skill or question; returns the systems, engineering stories, capabilities, ideas, technologies and patent applications that cover it, with measured results and links, and the agent roles that fit it.
examples: What has Corey James done with KV-cache offload on Intel GPUs?

skills.name: The agent gallery
skills.description: A function or a question about the agents Corey James has built; returns the roles in the agent gallery, each with the specialist agents that staff it. Each specialist does one job, and the same specialists are reused across roles.
examples: What agents has Corey James built for sales?
Which specialists staff the Chief of Staff role?

skills.name: Who this is
skills.description: Name, role, links and how to make contact.

skills.name: Pass a message
skills.description: Send a message to Corey James through the site's own form. Requires the sender's own name and email; never invented.
examples: Send Corey a note from Jane Doe <jane@example.com>: we would like to talk about a GPU inference role.
